requirements.title: ISHFT argument restrictions
requirements.definition: I shall be integer, SHIFT shall be integer, and ABS(SHIFT) shall not exceed BIT_SIZE(I).

requirements.title: ISHFT logical bit shift result value
requirements.definition: The ISHFT result is formed by shifting the bit sequence of I by SHIFT positions, left for positive SHIFT, right for negative SHIFT, unchanged for zero SHIFT, losing shifted-out bits and shifting zeros in from the opposite end.
